nearly still, only natural breathing — the artist holds the frame with quiet confidence
slow subtle head turn toward camera, locks eyes with the lens
the faintest nod, like acknowledging something only they understand
a slow exhale, shoulders drop slightly as if releasing tension
eyes drift down then slowly back up to camera, contemplative
jaw sets slightly, the look of someone who earned this
the corner of their mouth lifts barely — not a full smile, just satisfaction
a slow blink, maintaining eye contact, completely present
